{{Quote|Sith blood's not everything. Lord Thrain dislikes my apprentice's privileged attitude.|Ardran|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Thrain''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Thrain disliked the [[Ardran's apprentice|apprentice]] of [[Ardran]], who Thrain believed had a privileged attitude because of his [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] heritage.
